title: 第21章 银月刀与蛇鳞甲第22章 家族大比
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
江尘假扮成佣兵，进入佣兵据点内，有一些佣兵看到了江尘，也以为他是佣兵的一员。
毕竟一个据点好五六百人呢，分成不同的队伍，有一些人不认识也不奇怪。
江尘就这样在据点内转悠，也没有什么人怀疑他。
“这位兄弟，你在这儿干什么？上面已经通知说要集合了，你还不快点集合？否则缺席了，到时候可没有好果子吃。”
此时，一个佣兵看到江尘，连忙叫住。
“啊？是吗？我不知道。”
江尘道。
他们根本不知道江尘是敌人。
“这位大哥，过来，我有件事要跟你说。”
江尘叫这个佣兵过来。
这个人佣兵武者境六重，江尘能轻易地对付。
“有什么事？”
这个佣兵有点疑惑，并没有怀疑其他。
谁知道，刚来到江尘的面前，江尘直接动手，瞬间就制服了对方，捂住了对方的嘴。
“唔……”
这名佣兵大惊，现在傻子都知道江尘是敌人了。
但是已经晚了。
一把冰冷的匕首顶着佣兵的脖子。
现在周围没有人，江尘将对方拉到一个角落里。
“说，你们的库房在什么地方？”

江尘冷冷地道。
“给我指出一个方向。”
江尘接着道。
这个据点挺大的，江尘对此并不熟悉。
佣兵于是指了一个方向，江尘并没有放过对方，直接就给对方封喉了，尸体挣扎了几下之后就不动了。
这些佣兵恶事做尽，死有余辜。
本来这一次江尘就是前来杀人的。
江尘于是往那个方向走去，很快就发现了一个地下建筑入口，不过，那儿有十二人守着。
为首的是一个武师境二重的人，其他的都是武者境。
看来，血火佣兵团据点的宝库就在这儿了。
里面一般存放着血火佣兵团得来的战利品。
“十二人，如果我突然出手的话，那个武师境二重的强者应能杀掉。
其他的武者境不足为惧。”
江尘心里盘算。
江尘于是往宝库存的入口走去。
突然来了一个佣兵，守卫也是盯着江尘。
“站住，这儿是宝库重地，你来这儿干什么？”
队长冷冷地道。
“我来这儿，当然是杀你了。”
江尘道，说完，江尘还没有等对方反应过来，手中的长刀拔出。

“噗。”
这个小队长还没有反应过来，就被江尘封喉了。
content_en:
Jiang Chen pretended to be a mercenary and entered the mercenary stronghold. Some mercenaries saw Jiang Chen and thought he was a member of the mercenaries.
After all, there are five to six hundred people in a stronghold, divided into different teams. It is not surprising that some people do not know each other.
Jiang Chen was wandering around the stronghold like this, and no one suspected him.
"Brother, what are you doing here? We have been notified from above that we are going to gather. Why don't you gather quickly? Otherwise, if you are absent, there will be no good fruits to be had."
At this time, a mercenary saw Jiang Chen and quickly stopped him.
"Huh? Really? I don't know."
Jiang Chen said.
They had no idea that Jiang Chen was an enemy.
"Brother, come here, I have something to tell you."
Jiang Chen called this mercenary over.
This person is at the sixth level of the mercenary warrior realm, and Jiang Chen can easily deal with him.
"What's the matter?"
The mercenary was a little confused, but didn't suspect anything else.
Who would have known that when he came in front of Jiang Chen, Jiang Chen took action and subdued him in an instant and covered his mouth.
"Well..."
The mercenary was shocked. Now even a fool knows that Jiang Chen is an enemy.
But it's too late.
A cold dagger was pressed against the mercenary's neck.
There was no one around now, so Jiang Chen pulled the other person into a corner.
"Tell me, where is your warehouse?"
Jiang Chen said coldly.
"Point me in a direction."
Jiang Chen continued.
This stronghold is quite large, and Jiang Chen is not familiar with it.
The mercenary then pointed in a direction. Jiang Chen did not let go of the other party and immediately sealed his throat. The body struggled for a few times and then stopped moving.
These mercenaries have done all kinds of evil and deserve to die.
Originally, Jiang Chen came here to kill someone this time.
Jiang Chen then walked in that direction and soon found the entrance to an underground building, but there were twelve people guarding it.
The leader is a person who is at the second level of the martial arts realm, and the others are all at the martial arts realm.
It seems that the treasure trove of the Bloodfire Mercenary Group's stronghold is here.
It usually contains the trophies obtained by the Blood Fire Mercenary Group.
"Twelve people, if I take action suddenly, the strong man at the second level of the martial arts realm should be able to kill them.
There is nothing to fear from other warrior realms. "
Jiang Chen was thinking in his mind.
Jiang Chen then walked towards the entrance of the treasure house.
Suddenly a mercenary came, and the guard stared at Jiang Chen.
"Stop, this is a treasure house, what are you doing here?"
The captain said coldly.
"Of course I came here to kill you."
Jiang Chen said, after finishing speaking, Jiang Chen pulled out the long knife in his hand before the other party could react.
"Pfft."
Before the team leader could react, Jiang Chen blocked his throat.
